objective: Replace the research harness's single flat 12bps round-trip cost constant with a decomposed, per-instrument, provenance-carrying broker cost model (half-spread + commission + slippage + swap), and give forward_walk an opt-in adverse-fill model so stop-losses stop filling at exactly -1.000R regardless of gap. Both are additive and config-gated with defaults that reproduce today's output byte-for-byte. Seeds the metals_mt5 measurement profile from the repo's OWN already-MEASURED MT5 broker calibration (2026-08-06), which has sat unused while all three profiles declared calibration.status=PENDING_CALIBRATION. No re-measurement, no production activation, no economic claim in this change.

They carry NO vector_key, so CANONICAL_FEATURE_DIM stays 48 and every schema/vector hash is untouched; the frozen runtime-binding sections (primitives / feature_compositions / derived_metrics, read flat by crt_engine_v2 at import) are not edited. unknowns.statement: change_contracts.json registers no change class for the RESEARCH MEASUREMENT HARNESS (src/research/ costs, forward_walk, provenance, metrics). The closest class, RUNTIME_DECISION_PATH_CHANGE, is scoped to gates/engines/fusion/decision/planner/risk and does not apply: none of these files is imported by the live decision path. Declared non-blocking because the harness edits here are additive and parity-proved byte-identical, so no governed behaviour changes. Two pre-existing manifests (CH-visual-crt-trade-object, CH-va-xauusd-m15) worked around the same gap by declaring an unregistered class literal 'RESEARCH_ONLY', which validate_impact would reject at line 120 — evidence the gap is real and recurring, not specific to this change. Recommend registering a RESEARCH_HARNESS_CHANGE class in a separate governance turn.
unknowns.impact_if_wrong: A future research-harness change could alter measurement semantics without a declared contract or required checks.

unknowns.statement: All three measurement profiles declare cost_model_id 'derived_per_instrument.v1' with the placeholder formula 'k * median(bar_range_pct)' — deriving trading cost from VOLATILITY. This change seeds metals_mt5 with the measured BROKER decomposition instead, on the domain argument that cost is a broker property (spread/commission/slippage/swap), not a volatility property: a wider bar does not make a broker charge more. The placeholder is left in place alongside the measured block rather than deleted (CLAUDE.md 6.2 rule 4). Non-blocking because the seeded values are opt-in and default-unreachable.
unknowns.impact_if_wrong: If the volatility proxy was a deliberate frozen decision rather than a placeholder, the measured decomposition would need to be recorded as an alternative rather than a correction.
